engineering_objective: Repair the inherited Go fenced-fleet controller and Terraform EC2 module so a private payments ASG can complete a fenced pilot-then-wave rollout through the trusted local control plane.
required_end_state: Operator /app/bin/fenced-fleet-rollout regenerates /app/var/fleet/plan.json, commits inventory through /opt/ec2-controlplane, and leaves /app/output/rollout-report.json READY with a stable report_digest that matches a second identical run.
functional_requirements: Drive the public operator /app/bin/fenced-fleet-rollout so it regenerates /app/var/fleet/plan.json and writes /app/output/rollout-report.json.
Commit rendered inventory through the trusted control plane at /opt/ec2-controlplane; local JSON alone is not proof.
Release identity, launch-template AMI, provenance, and IMDSv2 follow /app/docs/fenced-fleet-contract.md and must not select ami_catalog.latest.
IAM is least-privilege with the four Allow Sids documented in /app/docs/iam-statements.md; wildcard actions are forbidden.
Placement uses only private_app IPAM-eligible subnets, preserves slot stickiness under subnet reorder, and never associates public IPs.
Rollout is pilot-then-wave with contracted events, max_unavailable, fail-closed health rollback, lost-reply resume, owner fencing, and target-release fencing.
Slot-owned volumes are encrypted with account KMS, stable IDs, generation-aware attachments, and canonical attachment tokens.
Legacy Slot-tag import reports the documented moved addresses; manual drift is report_only.
Journal repair truncates only an invalid final line and fails closed on interior corruption.
A second identical operator run keeps the same report_digest.
preservation_requirements: Keep the Go controller under /app/controller and /app/internal and Terraform under /app/terraform.
Do not replace /opt/ec2-controlplane with a forged binary; observed inventory must match the trusted control plane.
safety_requirements: Public-tier or ineligible IPAM subnets and invalid release manifests fail closed before mutation.
A different owner_token cannot resume an in-progress operation.
A mid-operation target-release change fails closed.
Interior journal corruption fails closed; only a torn tail may be truncated.

required_outputs.notes: Contracted report schema; status READY; stable report_digest; matching controller and control-plane digests.
Terraform plan JSON regenerated by the operator.

current_state_claims: The fleet picked an unapproved AMI alias, lost the control-plane reply after the pilot commit, and left a torn journal plus imported legacy addresses that still want destructive replacement.
